summary: Iteration 8 — Frontend-only testing of the new Tiles/Table view toggle on the Receival list. All acceptance criteria pass for both Admin and Staff. Default view is Tiles; Table view renders shadcn Table with correct columns; localStorage persistence works across reloads and detail navigation; both views share the same filtered set; supplier reassignment, checklist Switch toggles, Edit/View/Delete all work in table view for Admin; Staff sees read-only R/I/P badges, supplier name (no dropdown), and only the View action.
verified_scenarios: Admin login via tab-admin-login + login-email/login-password + login-submit
Clicking view-table renders receival-table with columns: Date, Supplier, Status, Received by, Invoice #, Slips, Photos, Pallets, Checklist, Actions (all present)
Admin table row exposes supplier-dropdown-<id>, toggle-recorded/invoice/price-<id>, edit-<id>, view-<id>, delete-<id>
Toggle-recorded flips aria-checked false→true (persisted, reverted successfully)
Search 'Global' filters to 1 row in Table view; switching to Tiles keeps same filter (parity)
Navigating to detail via view-<id> and back preserves Tiles view
Staff PIN login (1234) works; view-toggle present
Staff table view: supplier-name-<id> shown, supplier-dropdown-<id> absent, edit/delete absent, view-<id> present; read-only R/I/P badges visible in screenshot
critical_code_review_comments: ReceivalListPage.js is 703 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting the Table view, Tiles view and Edit dialog into separate components for maintainability.

Both Tiles and Table share identical data-testids (edit-<id>, view-<id>, delete-<id>, toggle-*-<id>, supplier-dropdown-<id>, supplier-name-<id>). Since only one view is rendered at a time this is fine, but any future test that queries all-<id> across DOM could get duplicates if both views are ever rendered simultaneously.
Seed data only shows 4 receivals in this environment (task note said ~11). Not a code bug, just an env observation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tiles use data-testid=receival-row-<id> (NOT receival-card-<id>). Table uses receival-trow-<id>. Both views share action testids (edit/view/delete/toggle-*/supplier-*), so scope queries to the visible view. localStorage key is 'eurasia_receival_filters' with viewMode field. Auth: eurasia_token in localStorage.
